problems.problem: Agent misunderstood the claim structure. The claim states 'Sir John Wedderburn and the brother of Henry Benedict Stuart fought in the uprising' (referring to two people), but agent interpreted it as claiming Wedderburn himself was the brother of Henry Benedict Stuart. Agent incorrectly concluded the claim is false based on this misreading.
